### PUT IT ALL ON VANDERPUMP! BRAVO HITS THE JACKPOT WHEN 'VANDERPUMP RULES: LISA LAS VEGAS' PREMIERES TUESDAY, OCT. 20 AT 9 P.M. ET/PT


09/30/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/2026/Sep/30/Bravo-PRESS-RELEASE-Vanderpump-Rules_-Lisa-Las-Vegas-1.pdf)


**PUT IT ALL ON VANDERPUMP! BRAVO HITS THE JACKPOT WHEN 'VANDERPUMP RULES: LISA LAS VEGAS' PREMIERES TUESDAY, OCT. 20 AT 9 P.M. ET/PT**


**It’s a Vanderpump Takeover on Bravo with All Three Episodes of Limited Series Airing as a Two-Night Special Event**


**Fan Favorites from "Vanderpump Rules" Take a SURprise Road Trip to Help Lisa Launch The Vanderpump Hotel**


- The Vanderpump empire is taking over Sin City when “Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas” premieres on Tuesday, Oct. 20 at 9 p.m. ET/PT with a two-episode premiere event. The third and final episode will air on Wednesday, Oct. 21 at 9 p.m. ET/PT.


- All episodes of “Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas” will be available to stream next day on Peacock.


- Lisa Vanderpump has been reigning over the Las Vegas Strip for years now with three hotspot restaurants serving up chic cocktails, over-the-top glamour and her signature brand of whimsy. Once again partnering with Caesars Entertainment, she’s betting big on her most ambitious Vegas venture yet: a namesake hotel. This isn’t just another grand opening; it’s Lisa’s biggest gamble to date and a chance to cement her legacy. With a to-do list longer than the Strip itself, LVP and her A-Team pull back the curtain on what it really takes to get a boutique resort ready for its lavish opening – and VIP check in – Vanderpump style.


- In a race against the clock to make the property worthy of the Vanderpump name and be ready in time for the hotel’s grand opening, Lisa is joined by her husband Ken Todd, daughter Pandora Vanderpump Sabo, longtime business partner Nick Alain and a trusted team of collaborators. Longtime friend Kevin Lee is also back in Lisa’s orbit after a stint working with one of her rivals.


- The down-to-the-wire drama wouldn’t be complete without some SURvers lending a helping hand. Natalie Maguire, Venus Binkley, Chris Hahn, Angelica Jensen, Marcus Johnson, and Audrey Lingle take a road trip in support of Lisa.


- The Vanderpump takeover extends beyond Bravo. Lisa’s debut book, “Home at Villa Rosa: Cooking and Living the Vanderpump Way,” is on sale Oct. 13. This unique and revealing look into Lisa’s world includes 70 recipes, stunning photography, and tips on how to cook and live like a Vanderpump.


**"Part 1: Vegas? That’s Epic, Baby!"**


*Tuesday, Oct. 20 at 9 p.m. ET/PT*


Lisa Vanderpump gets the chance to open up her very own hotel on the Las Vegas Strip, but she and her team feel the pressure as they attempt to check everything off their never-ending to-do list. Walking into the space, everything feels like a construction site and Lisa fears those around her have a lack of urgency. Also on the agenda? Making up with a former friend and reminding her SURvers that photoshoots are work, not play.


**"Part 2: If It Was Easy, Everyone Would Do It"**


*Tuesday, Oct. 20 at 10 p.m. ET/PT*


With time running out, Lisa and her team rush to put the finishing touches on the hotel. Guests begin to check in before all the rooms are ready and late deliveries, holes in the ceiling, and complaining guests threaten to derail the opening. At home, Lisa opens up about how her childhood affected her drive to succeed.


**"Part 3: Misbehave Accordingly"** ****


*Wednesday, Oct. 21 at 9 p.m. ET/PT*


Lisa Vanderpump has opened 39 restaurants and now finally, her very own hotel. With celebrity guests arriving in droves to celebrate the grand opening party, excitement is at an all-time high, but so are the expectations. Lisa only gets one chance to make a lasting first impression and the pressure is on for The Vanderpump Hotel to keep the momentum going long after the party ends.


“Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas” is produced by 32 Flavors, a part of Sony Pictures Television and Evolution Media, an MGM Company. Alex Baskin, Michael Beck, Natalie Neurauter, Brian McCarthy, Brittany Nabors, Barry Poznick, Lisa Vanderpump and Ken Todd executive produce.
